positive_signals: MeClear is a task-conditioned memory clearance framework that combines Leave-One-Out screening with sampled cooperative Shapley attribution and verified query-scoped clearance.

The paper identifies a gap: single-record deletion fails under redundant harmful memories because each fault masks the other's local effect, and existing retrieval-time filters do not verify behavioral recovery.

The evaluation uses causally verified fault injection with behavioral verification: clean contexts must remain correct in both trials, direct conflicts must corrupt both trials, and redundant conflicts must remain incorrect when either fault is retained alone.
